generic_opportunity: First close above the prior 20-session high after a 20-session cooldown, followed by a tradable next-open entry; SH/SZ stocks, close 3 to 300 and signal-day amount at least CNY 20 million.
labels: Post-entry 40-tradable-session MFE and close return, plus geometric excess over the daily rebalanced SH/SZ equal-weight market. Future bars are labels only.
direction_rule: A gate may motivate one new structural relaxation only if it is the largest first-failure source among missed +20% paths, has at least 100 such paths, and its omitted cohort has positive average 40-session alpha in at least four training years. Otherwise do not register a relaxation from this funnel.
constraints: Do not alter thresholds or gate order after reading outcomes.
Do not use 2023-2026 data for direction selection.
The funnel selects at most one method-level relaxation and does not validate a strategy.
